lookupStrategies.accepts: localized alias, English/alias enum constant, internal; case-insensitive
lookupStrategies.mechanism: Command(kernel,name,true) -> App.getReverseCommand -> Localization.getReverseCommand: reverse table by lower-case key, else Commands.lookupInternal

lookupStrategies.accepts: any Commands enum constant name (internal or English alias), case-insensitive; never localized aliases
lookupStrategies.mechanism: Commands.lookupInternal(name) -> englishToInternal; unknown name kept verbatim

lookupStrategies.accepts: exact-case Commands enum constant names only (internal or English alias constant)
RENAMED set, then the first enum-order command whose UI-locale localized name matches case-insensitively; otherwise the token is kept verbatim
lookupStrategies.note: precedence differs from the reverse table: first match wins here, last writer wins there

reverseTableRules: built by App.fillCommandDict iterating Commands in declaration order, skipping constants rejected by the command filters (GeoCeDG: dedicated LocusV2 commands when creation is disabled)
hidden tables: TABLE_CAS and TABLE_ENGLISH always, TABLE_3D unless 3D commands are enabled (AppGeoCeDG: enabled); a hidden TABLE_ENGLISH constant inserts only its own lower-case name, if absent

visible constant: lower-case internal name inserted only if absent; lower-case localized name inserted with overwrite (putInTranslateCommandTable -> englishToInternal, then addCommandEntry -> comm.name())
App.fillCasCommandDict (only once the CAS object exists) re-inserts CAS command localized names with overwrite
consequence: a localized alias always wins over an internal/English name with the same lower-case key; among colliding localized aliases the last writer wins
table freshness: AppD.setLanguage -> setLabels -> updateCommandDictionary rebuilds it; a bare setLocale does not (test-harness caveat)

commandInventory.processorEquivalenceMethod: englishToInternal plus shared-processor case groups of the command-processor factories
